	COLDWAR_PK_dec_zone = {
		icon = COLDWAR_PK_zone
		allowed = { always = yes }
		state_target = yes
		on_map_mode = map_only
		target_root_trigger = {
			COLDWAR_OBS_human = yes
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_hosts^num > 0 }
		}
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_zone }
				OWNER = {
					is_in_array = { array = ROOT.COLDWAR_PK_hosts value = THIS }
					NOT = { ROOT = { is_in_array = { array = COLDWAR_PK_shoot value = PREV } } }
					controls_state = PREV
					# one Protected Zone per mission (Enes 24.11.2026)
					NOT = { any_owned_state = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_zone has_variable = COLDWAR_PK_sender var:COLDWAR_PK_sender = { tag = ROOT } } }
				}
			}
		}
		highlight_states = {
			highlight_states_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_zone }
				OWNER = { is_in_array = { array = ROOT.COLDWAR_PK_hosts value = THIS } }
			}
			highlight_color_before_active = 3
		}
		fire_only_once = no
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_PK_dec_zone in [From.GetName]"
			FROM = {
				set_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_zone
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_sender = ROOT }
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_zone }
				OWNER = {
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_zone_n = 1 }
					COLDWAR_PK_apply_task = yes
				}
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_zones = 1 }
			COLDWAR_PK_prepare_uniform_template = yes
			capital_scope = { COLDWAR_PK_spawn_here = yes } # raised at home: HOI4 creates no units in foreign provinces
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
	}

			# MD form (CYP) needs a tag: the tag is filled in with meta_effect
			meta_effect = {
				text = { add_relation_rule_override = { target = [TAG] can_send_volunteers = yes } }
				TAG = "[FROM.GetTag]"
			}
			COLDWAR_PK_volunteer_recalc = yes
			save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_PK_snd
			FROM = { COLDWAR_PK_release_pair = yes }
			save_global_event_target_as = COLDWAR_PK_news_sender
			FROM = { save_global_event_target_as = COLDWAR_PK_news_host }
			every_country = { limit = { exists = yes } news_event = { id = COLDWAR_PK.3 hours = 6 } }
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 0 }

		fire_only_once = no
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_PK_dec_stand_down for [From.GetName]"
			FROM = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_PK_tgt }
			COLDWAR_PK_stand_down = yes
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
	}
}
